features.feature_name: Oracle Automatic Storage Management support for Oracle Database on SAP NetWeaver
features.feature_summary: SAP and Oracle have validated Oracle Automatic Storage Management for running Oracle Database with SAP NetWeaver-based applications on Google Cloud.
features.extended_definition: SAP and Oracle have validated Oracle Automatic Storage Management for running Oracle Database with SAP NetWeaver-based applications on Google Cloud.

features.feature_name: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP version 2
features.feature_summary: Version 2 of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP has reached end of support; deprecated on 2025-07-31.
features.extended_definition: Version 2 of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP has reached end of support; deprecated on 2025-07-31.

features.feature_name: Terraform NFS support for SAP HANA scale-out high-availability deployments
features.feature_summary: Terraform can use existing NFS solutions to share /hana/shared and /hanabackup volumes with worker hosts in SAP HANA scale-out high-availability deployments.
features.extended_definition: Terraform can use existing NFS solutions to share /hana/shared and /hanabackup volumes with worker hosts in SAP HANA scale-out high-availability deployments.

features.feature_name: SAPHanaSR-angi support for SAP HANA high-availability clusters
features.feature_summary: SAP HANA high-availability clusters on SLES 15 SP6 for SAP and later can use the SAPHanaSR-angi package, with automatic installation and configuration in the latest Terraform module.
features.extended_definition: SAP HANA high-availability clusters on SLES 15 SP6 for SAP and later can use the SAPHanaSR-angi package, with automatic installation and configuration in the latest Terraform module.

features.feature_name: Terraform support for SAP HANA sole-tenant node deployments
features.feature_summary: Terraform can deploy multiple SAP HANA configurations on sole-tenant nodes, including scale-up, high-availability, and scale-out variants.
features.extended_definition: Terraform can deploy multiple SAP HANA configurations on sole-tenant nodes, including scale-up, high-availability, and scale-out variants.

features.feature_name: Simple Mount architecture for SAP NetWeaver high-availability clusters
features.feature_summary: SAP NetWeaver Central Services high-availability clusters can be deployed using the Simple Mount architecture.
features.extended_definition: SAP NetWeaver Central Services high-availability clusters can be deployed using the Simple Mount architecture.

features.feature_name: Striped disk support for the SAP HANA /hana/data directory
features.feature_summary: Terraform can provision a striped disk to host the SAP HANA /hana/data directory during supported SAP HANA deployments.
features.extended_definition: Terraform can provision a striped disk to host the SAP HANA /hana/data directory during supported SAP HANA deployments.

features.feature_name: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP version 1
features.feature_summary: Version 1 of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP has reached end of support; deprecated on 2024-09-13.
features.extended_definition: Version 1 of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP has reached end of support; deprecated on 2024-09-13.

features.feature_name: Disk snapshot-based backup and recovery for SAP HANA
features.feature_summary: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP version 3.0 can use disk snapshots to perform backup and recovery for SAP HANA systems.
features.extended_definition: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP version 3.0 can use disk snapshots to perform backup and recovery for SAP HANA systems.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA Fast Restart
features.feature_summary: SAP HANA Fast Restart is enabled when deploying SAP HANA on Google Cloud with supported Terraform modules.
features.extended_definition: SAP HANA Fast Restart is enabled when deploying SAP HANA on Google Cloud with supported Terraform modules.

features.feature_name: Persistent Disk Asynchronous Replication
features.feature_summary: Persistent Disk Asynchronous Replication supports cross-region active-passive disaster recovery for SAP HANA and SAP NetWeaver.
features.extended_definition: Persistent Disk Asynchronous Replication supports cross-region active-passive disaster recovery for SAP HANA and SAP NetWeaver.

features.feature_name: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP OS image packaging
features.feature_summary: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP is bundled with all RHEL for SAP images and with SLES 15 SP4 for SAP and later images.
features.extended_definition: Google Cloud's Agent for SAP is bundled with all RHEL for SAP images and with SLES 15 SP4 for SAP and later images.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA deployment automation static IP address support
features.feature_summary: Terraform-based SAP HANA deployment automation can assign static IP addresses to master, worker, standby, primary, and secondary VM instances.
features.extended_definition: Terraform-based SAP HANA deployment automation can assign static IP addresses to master, worker, standby, primary, and secondary VM instances.

features.feature_name: Monitoring Agent for SAP HANA
features.feature_summary: The Google Cloud monitoring agent for SAP HANA is deprecated and replaced by SAP HANA monitoring metrics collection in Agent for SAP v2.0; deprecated on 2024-05-31.
features.extended_definition: The Google Cloud monitoring agent for SAP HANA is deprecated and replaced by SAP HANA monitoring metrics collection in Agent for SAP v2.0; deprecated on 2024-05-31.

features.feature_name: Default separate SAP volume disks
features.feature_summary: Terraform automation for SAP HANA now mounts SAP volumes on separate SSD-based persistent disks or Hyperdisks by default.
features.extended_definition: Terraform automation for SAP HANA now mounts SAP volumes on separate SSD-based persistent disks or Hyperdisks by default.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA backup disk option
features.feature_summary: Scale-up SAP HANA Terraform deployments can provision a backup disk with the include_backup_disk argument.
features.extended_definition: Scale-up SAP HANA Terraform deployments can provision a backup disk with the include_backup_disk argument.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA deployment automation disk type selection
features.feature_summary: Terraform automation for SAP HANA lets you choose the default SAP volume disk type with the disk_type argument, including Hyperdisk Extreme.
features.extended_definition: Terraform automation for SAP HANA lets you choose the default SAP volume disk type with the disk_type argument, including Hyperdisk Extreme.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA shared data-log disk option
features.feature_summary: Terraform automation for SAP HANA can mount all SAP volumes on a single disk using the use_single_shared_data_log_disk argument.
features.extended_definition: Terraform automation for SAP HANA can mount all SAP volumes on a single disk using the use_single_shared_data_log_disk argument.

features.feature_name: Monitoring Agent for SAP NetWeaver
features.feature_summary: The Google Cloud monitoring agent for SAP NetWeaver is deprecated and replaced by Google Cloud's Agent for SAP; deprecated on 2024-02-14.
features.extended_definition: The Google Cloud monitoring agent for SAP NetWeaver is deprecated and replaced by Google Cloud's Agent for SAP; deprecated on 2024-02-14.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA deployment automation gVNIC support
features.feature_summary: Terraform and Deployment Manager automation for SAP HANA can use Google Virtual NIC through the nic_type argument.
features.extended_definition: Terraform and Deployment Manager automation for SAP HANA can use Google Virtual NIC through the nic_type argument.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA high-availability Deployment Manager template for RHEL
features.feature_summary: Google Cloud's Deployment Manager template for Linux high-availability SAP HANA clusters now supports Red Hat Enterprise Linux images.
features.extended_definition: Google Cloud's Deployment Manager template for Linux high-availability SAP HANA clusters now supports Red Hat Enterprise Linux images.

features.feature_name: Monitoring Agent for SAP HANA v1.0
features.feature_summary: Version 1.0 of the Google Cloud monitoring agent for SAP HANA is deprecated in favor of v2.0; deprecated on 2021-12-31.
features.extended_definition: Version 1.0 of the Google Cloud monitoring agent for SAP HANA is deprecated in favor of v2.0; deprecated on 2021-12-31.

features.feature_name: gceStorageClient for SAP HANA host auto-failover v1.n
features.feature_summary: Version 1.n releases of gceStorageClient for SAP HANA host auto-failover are deprecated in favor of version 2.0, the Google Cloud Storage Manager for SAP HANA Standby Nodes; deprecated on 2021-12-31.
features.extended_definition: Version 1.n releases of gceStorageClient for SAP HANA host auto-failover are deprecated in favor of version 2.0, the Google Cloud Storage Manager for SAP HANA Standby Nodes; deprecated on 2021-12-31.

features.feature_name: Google Cloud Storage Manager for SAP HANA Standby Nodes
features.feature_summary: Version 2.0 of gceStorageClient for SAP HANA host auto-failover is available as Google Cloud Storage Manager for SAP HANA Standby Nodes and uses RPM Package Manager for installation and updates.
features.extended_definition: Version 2.0 of gceStorageClient for SAP HANA host auto-failover is available as Google Cloud Storage Manager for SAP HANA Standby Nodes and uses RPM Package Manager for installation and updates.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA alias-IP VIP deployment template for SLES
features.feature_summary: The sap_hana_ha/template.yaml deployment template for SLES high-availability clusters using an alias-IP virtual IP implementation is deprecated in favor of the TCP internal load balancer version; deprecated on 2020-11-25.
features.extended_definition: The sap_hana_ha/template.yaml deployment template for SLES high-availability clusters using an alias-IP virtual IP implementation is deprecated in favor of the TCP internal load balancer version; deprecated on 2020-11-25.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA TCP internal load balancer VIP deployment template for SLES
features.feature_summary: Google Cloud now supports automating SAP HANA deployment in SLES high-availability clusters with the recommended TCP internal load balancer virtual IP implementation.
features.extended_definition: Google Cloud now supports automating SAP HANA deployment in SLES high-availability clusters with the recommended TCP internal load balancer virtual IP implementation.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA persistent disk storage
features.feature_summary: Guidance for using Compute Engine persistent disks, including balanced persistent disks, with SAP applications and SAP HANA on Google Cloud.
features.extended_definition: Guidance for using Compute Engine persistent disks, including balanced persistent disks, with SAP applications and SAP HANA on Google Cloud.

features.feature_name: Cloud Storage Backint agent for SAP HANA
features.feature_summary: The Cloud Storage Backint agent for SAP HANA is deprecated and replaced by the Backint feature in version 3.0 of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP; The Cloud Storage Backint agent for SAP HANA provides backup integration with Cloud Storage and includes encryption options and other enhancements; deprecated on 2025-02-28.
features.extended_definition: The Cloud Storage Backint agent for SAP HANA is deprecated and replaced by the Backint feature in version 3.0 of Google Cloud's Agent for SAP; The Cloud Storage Backint agent for SAP HANA provides backup integration with Cloud Storage and includes encryption options and other enhancements; deprecated on 2025-02-28.

features.feature_name: OS-native HA clusters for SAP HANA on Google Cloud
features.feature_summary: Guidance for SAP HANA high-availability deployments using OS-native cluster configurations on Google Cloud.
features.extended_definition: Guidance for SAP HANA high-availability deployments using OS-native cluster configurations on Google Cloud.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA high availability deployment guidance
features.feature_summary: Guidance for deploying SAP HANA in a high-availability configuration, including migration from alias IP to an internal load balancer for the virtual IP.
features.extended_definition: Guidance for deploying SAP HANA in a high-availability configuration, including migration from alias IP to an internal load balancer for the virtual IP.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA Linux HA cluster configuration on RHEL
features.feature_summary: Guidance for configuring a Linux high-availability cluster for SAP HANA on Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
features.extended_definition: Guidance for configuring a Linux high-availability cluster for SAP HANA on Red Hat Enterprise Linux.

features.feature_name: SAP HANA Linux HA cluster configuration on SLES
features.feature_summary: Guidance for configuring a Linux high-availability cluster for SAP HANA on SUSE Linux Enterprise Server.
features.extended_definition: Guidance for configuring a Linux high-availability cluster for SAP HANA on SUSE Linux Enterprise Server.
